Summary

COADM01C is a CICS online program that serves as the Administrative Menu for the CardDemo application, presenting admin users with a list of available administrative options and routing them to the appropriate sub-programs based on their selection. The program handles user input validation, displays up to 10 menu options dynamically built from a common area, and transfers control to the selected option's program via XCTL or returns the user to the sign-on screen. It operates as a Main/Driver program, receiving control from the sign-on screen and dispatching to other administrative modules.
- **Execution Environment**: Online (CICS) - **Database Access**: None - **MQ Calls**: No - **Module Type**: Main/Driver module
### Key Functionalities: 1: Session Validation - Check if the user session is active by verifying the communication area. If no session exists, redirect the user to the Sign-On screen to authenticate before accessing the Admin Menu. 2: Initial Admin Menu Display - On the first entry to the Admin Menu, initialize the screen and display the Admin Menu to the user with all available administrative options populated. 3: Admin Menu Screen Rendering - Build and send the Admin Menu screen to the user, including current date, current time, application title, program name, transaction ID, and all available menu options. 4: Header Information Population - Populate the screen header with the current date (MM/DD/YY format), current time (HH:MM:SS format), application titles, transaction ID, and program name for display on the Admin Menu screen. 5: Menu Options Construction - Dynamically build and display up to 10 administrative menu options on the screen by combining each option number and option name from the configured list of admin options. 6: User Input Capture - Receive and capture the user's input from the Admin Menu screen, including the option number entered by the user. 7: Enter Key Processing - Process the user's menu selection when the Enter key is pressed, including reading the entered option value and preparing it for validation. 8: Menu Option Validation - Validate the user-entered option to ensure it is numeric, non-zero, and within the valid range of available administrative options. Display an error message if the option is invalid. 9: Navigate to Selected Admin Function - Transfer control to the selected administrative program based on the user's valid menu option selection, passing the communication area to maintain session context. 10: Uninstalled Option Handling - Display an informational message in green indicating that the selected menu option is not yet installed, when the selected program is marked as a dummy or is not available. 11: Return to Sign-On Screen - Transfer control back to the Sign-On screen when the user presses PF3 or when no valid session exists, effectively logging the user out of the Admin Menu. 12: Invalid Key Handling - Display an error message to the user when an unsupported key (other than Enter or PF3) is pressed on the Admin Menu screen, prompting the user to use a valid key. 13: Missing Program Error Handling - When a selected administrative program cannot be found or is not installed, display a green informational message indicating the option is not installed and return the user to the Admin Menu.

Field Name Type Length Description

1. MAIN-PARA – Entry Point and Screen Flow Control - Clears the error message field on the screen: MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE ERRMSGO OF COADM1AO - On first entry (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER), initializes the output map and sends the menu screen: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COADM1AO PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN - On re-entry (CDEMO-PGM-REENTER), receives the screen input and evaluates the key pressed: PERFORM RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN DFHENTER → PERFORM PROCESS-ENTER-KEY WHEN DFHPF3 → PERFORM RETURN-TO-SIGNON-SCREEN WHEN OTHER → Sets error flag, moves CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY to WS-MESSAGE, PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN 2. PROCESS-ENTER-KEY – Handles ENTER Key Processing - Reads and trims the user-entered option from the OPTION input field: PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM LENGTH OF OPTIONI OF COADM1AI BY -1 UNTIL OPTIONI OF COADM1AI(WS-IDX:1) NOT = SPACES OR WS-IDX = 1 MOVE OPTIONI OF COADM1AI(1:WS-IDX) TO WS-OPTION-X INSPECT WS-OPTION-X REPLACING ALL ' ' BY '0' MOVE WS-OPTION-X TO WS-OPTION - Reflects the entered option back to the output map: MOVE WS-OPTION TO OPTIONO OF COADM1AO - Validates the entered option (must be numeric, non-zero, and within valid range): IF WS-OPTION IS NOT NUMERIC OR WS-OPTION > CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT OR WS-OPTION = ZEROS MOVE 'Y' TO WS-ERR-FLG MOVE 'Please enter a valid option number...' TO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN - If valid, transfers control to the selected program via XCTL: EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-PGMNAME(WS-OPTION)) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) END-EXEC - If the selected program is a DUMMY or not installed, displays a message: MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF COADM1AO STRING 'This option ' ... 'is not installed ...' INTO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN 3. SEND-MENU-SCREEN – Sends the Admin Menu Screen to the Terminal - Calls header population and menu option building: PERFORM POPULATE-HEADER-INFO PERFORM BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS - Moves the message to the error message output field: MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO OF COADM1AO - Sends the BMS map to the terminal: EXEC CICS SEND MAP('COADM1A') MAPSET('COADM01') FROM(COADM1AO) ERASE END-EXEC 4. RECEIVE-MENU-SCREEN – Receives Input from the Admin Menu Screen - Reads user input from the terminal into the input map: EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COADM1A') MAPSET('COADM01') INTO(COADM1AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD) END-EXEC 5. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO – Populates Screen Header Fields - Gets the current system date and time: MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA - Populates the title fields: MOVE CCDA-TITLE01 TO TITLE01O OF COADM1AO MOVE CCDA-TITLE02 TO TITLE02O OF COADM1AO - Populates the transaction ID and program name: MOVE WS-TRANID TO TRNNAMEO OF COADM1AO MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO PGMNAMEO OF COADM1AO - Formats and populates the date field: MOVE WS-CURDATE-MONTH TO WS-CURDATE-MM MOVE WS-CURDATE-DAY TO WS-CURDATE-DD MOVE WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2) TO WS-CURDATE-YY MOVE WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY TO CURDATEO OF COADM1AO - Formats and populates the time field: MOVE WS-CURTIME-HOURS TO WS-CURTIME-HH MOVE WS-CURTIME-MINUTE TO WS-CURTIME-MM MOVE WS-CURTIME-SECOND TO WS-CURTIME-SS MOVE WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS TO CURTIMEO OF COADM1AO 6. BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS – Populates Menu Option Display Fields - Loops through all defined admin options (up to CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT = 6): PERFORM VARYING WS-IDX FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL WS-IDX > CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT - Builds each option text string (number + name): STRING CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NUM(WS-IDX) DELIMITED BY SIZE '. ' DELIMITED BY SIZE CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-NAME(WS-IDX) DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT - Maps each option text to the corresponding screen output field: WHEN 1 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN001O OF COADM1AO WHEN 2 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN002O OF COADM1AO WHEN 3 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN003O OF COADM1AO WHEN 4 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN004O OF COADM1AO WHEN 5 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN005O OF COADM1AO WHEN 6 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN006O OF COADM1AO WHEN 7 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN007O OF COADM1AO WHEN 8 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN008O OF COADM1AO WHEN 9 → MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN009O OF COADM1AO WHEN 10→ MOVE WS-ADMIN-OPT-TXT TO OPTN010O OF COADM1AO 7. PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA – Handles Program Not Found Error - Displays a "not installed" message in the error field when a selected program cannot be found: MOVE DFHGREEN TO ERRMSGC OF COADM1AO STRING 'This option ' ... 'is not installed ...' INTO WS-MESSAGE PERFORM SEND-MENU-SCREEN
